Commentary: 14:22 Local Time, 01:22 GMT, 06:52 IST: NZ end with 356. Akash Deep not denied a fifer. India will not be chuffed with their performance today. They would feel at least 50 runs too many. The wicket might not have the same bite like it did yesterday but there is still enough to play with for the seamers. India were shoddy with their fielding and that has costed them further. Three proper chances off Henry went down and even a few close run-out chances were not converted. And India will have more reasons to worry as Bumrah remained wicketless. He looked jaded as well and didn't hit the full tilt that we are so used to. But NZ have the advantage and will look to have a good phase with the ball in the middle session. Indian openers will have the onus again to survive the new ball and lay a platform the rest of the batting order. Henry and co. are itching to go out...

26 overs is the joint-most bowled by Jasprit Bumrah without bagging a single wicket in a Test innings. He had returned 0/57 against the same opponent in the WTC 2021 final in Southampton and 0/79 against England at Lord’s in 2021 - both in 26 overs.
